from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    for color in colors:
        seen = set()
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen:
                    continue
                q = deque([(r,c)])
                seen.add((r,c))
                comp = []
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
                c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
                if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2:
                    continue
                # A frame has a complete rectangular perimeter and an empty interior.
                if not (all(grid[r0][x]==color and grid[r1][x]==color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                        all(grid[y][c0]==color and grid[y][c1]==color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                    continue
                inside = [(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)]
                if any(grid[y][x] != grid[r0+1][c0+1] for y,x in inside):
                    continue
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 else 2
                for y,x in inside:
                    out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''
